notes.title: Shank The Cop Update 1.1
notes.content:
This is a minor update to Shank the Cop. The update includes the following:
[list]
[*] Reworked the games menu to make it more intuitive
[*] Minor Bug Fixes
[*] Some Users were having difficulty starting a game. Reworking the UI has made this process easier.
[/list]
